Website and event design

Conexus

Carrying a new identity into the web and the room

Client
Conexus
Year
2025
Role
Creative Lead
Scope
Website · Event design

After Conexus’s rebrand, I carried the new identity into its two most visible touchpoints: the website and its first post-rebrand event.

01   The website

Designing inside
the limits

Security requirements narrowed the hosting options, making HostPapa’s website builder the practical choice for the project.

I designed and built the website around the platform’s constraints, using considered layouts, clear hierarchy and consistent visual elements to create a cohesive digital experience.

The result was a polished, functional website that brought the Conexus identity online and remains live today.

02   The event

Charge up for
a cleaner future

For Conexus’s first event following its rebrand, the goal was to introduce the refreshed identity and make its clean-energy message tangible.

I developed interactive event concepts that encouraged attendees to participate, contribute and engage with the brand.

The interactive pin-map activity invited attendees to participate, share their perspectives, and become part of the conversation. Designed to encourage collaboration and meaningful engagement, it transformed a complex industry message into an approachable, shared experience.
